products.title: Recliner RX6 - Single Seater Suede Fabric Recliner (Mocha Brown)
products.body_html: Pamper yourself with the ultimate relaxation experience courtesy of our super comfy recliner – it's not just furniture; it's your private chill-out spot. We've put a lot of thought into this recliner's design. With extra padding on the neck rest that cradles you like a pro, akin to a business class seat, offering unparalleled comfort. Sink into its pocket spring seat, it's your go-to spot for unwinding after a long day. It rocks a robust solid wood frame, promising a long-lasting and steady addition to your home sweet home. The recliner's body is a plush haven, offering you a warm and cosy seat to sink into. What makes this recliner stand out is its versatility. With three modes – sit, lounge, and recline – it's got all the moves to help you find your ideal comfy zone. Whether you're lost in a good book, binging your latest TV obsession, or simply taking it easy, this recliner has your back. The backrest and knee-rest sport a stylish striped quilted texture that not only looks great but also feels soft against your skin. To kick your comfort up a notch, we've added pocket springs to the seat, giving you extra cushioning, bounce, and an all-around plush vibe. The tufted premium foam takes your seating experience to the next level by providing top-notch support. Wrapped in a super soft and durable premium suede fabric, available in elegant basil green and mocha brown, our recliner doesn't just complement your home decor – it adds a touch of luxury to your living space. Changing your recliner's position is a breeze thanks to the manual lever function, letting you seamlessly switch between sitting, lounging, and reclining. The ergonomic design prioritizes support for your lower back and neck, with extra cushioning on the backrest and headrest, ensuring your relaxation is not just comfy but also good for your well-being. Upgrade your living space with our fabulous recliner and take your relaxation game to the next level. It's not just a chair; it's your cozy retreat, where you can unwind and enjoy ultimate comfort.

products.title: Technic - 3 Zone 6D Hexagon Grid Mattress #FutureofSleep
products.body_html:
We know honeybees are nature’s small architects, and their honeycomb is known for its hexagonal structure, which provides strong, medium-firm support and long-lasting durability. We've adapted the same principle to our mattress. Introducing Sleepyhead’s Technic Mattress, India’s first 6D hexagonal grid mattress combining medium firm comfort with superior design quality, much like nature intended.


The latest 6D Hexagon Grid Technology revolutionises sleep with advanced support and comfort, and 3 Zones for Uniform Pressure Distribution. The mattress doesn’t sag like other grid structures and strikes the ideal balance between softness and support. The reinforced central zone takes your back's needs seriously, promoting optimal spinal alignment and exceptional back support. Technic provides tailored support across different body parts, ensuring uniform pressure distribution for optimal comfort and a restful sleep.


Mattress features a hexagon structure with 3000+ Air Channels for promoting airflow, giving you a cooling surface for an undisturbed sleep experience. The multi-layered design with a super soft foam layer provides a gentle cradle and plush feeling, while the HR foam layer offers exceptional durability and optimal support. Enjoy the ultimate sleep experience with the confidence of a 100-night trial period and a 10-year warranty.
